RTARIUM hero storyboard

From the opening screen to "The challenge": 14 frames of the real page at 1440 × 900, captured at fixed scroll positions. The page is 6300 px tall up to The challenge: the opening tour (4 screens), then About (3 steps).

0102030405060708091011121314

A · Opening tour

Scroll 0 – 3600 px

One scroll-driven sequence: the headline dissolves into the mesh, the camera goes between the faces, out through white light, then into the yarn.

  1. 010 px

    Meet RTARIUM.

    Headline left, a strip of mesh receding to the upper right with callouts (3D spacer structure, basalt yarn, two offset faces). Explore slab and scroll cue.

  2. 02450 px

    The headline dissolves

    First scroll: the headline has gone into the mesh, which is built out toward full screen.

  3. 03900 px

    Two basalt faces, woven as one.

    Mesh fills the screen. The statement sits on a black slab, bottom right. The cursor presses a hollow into the mesh.

  4. 041350 px

    Between them, a cavity

    Camera drops toward the surface while the second statement replaces the first.

  5. 051800 px

    Inside the cavity

    Drawing-style notes: upper face, connecting fibres, lower face, and the 10 mm depth dimensioned.

  6. 062250 px

    Into white light

    The tour runs on into white; the ground washes to warm white as "Concrete, better than ever." rises from the bottom edge.

  7. 072700 px

    Concrete, better than ever.

    Warm-white screen: a tile of mesh half cast in concrete, headline left, one supporting line.

  8. 083150 px

    Into the yarn

    The camera goes into the mesh. This is the cut-free hand-off into About: no copy, just the basalt.

B · About RTARIUM

Scroll 3600 – 6300 px

Runs sideways: the chapter is pinned and one mesh moves between steps. Step chips along the bottom.

  1. 093600 px

    Structure

    "A mesh with a third dimension." Labels on upper face, connecting fibres, lower face; thickness options 3 / 6 / 10 / 15 mm.

  2. 104500 px

    Material

    "Woven from volcanic rock." Copy in a top band, four making-stations, the rovings as a panorama below.

  3. 115400 px

    In concrete: mesh and footage

    First movement: mesh on the left, copy top right and the production footage bottom right.

  4. 125400 px

    In concrete: cast panel

    Later in the same step: mortar has flowed in, the camera stands back to the cast panel, and three numbered notes appear.

C · Hand-off to Why

Scroll 5850 – 6300 px

About ends on yellow; the black ground of "The challenge" rises along one edge.

  1. 135850 px

    The black ground rises

    Mid-transition: The challenge comes up from the bottom edge over About’s last step.

  2. 146300 px

    The challenge

    "Thin concrete has relied on steel fibre, glass fibre and flat mesh. Each brings a weakness with it." Yellow on black.

Seen while capturing

  • Frame 06: the white-light screen is empty for a stretch (about the top 80% of the viewport) before the headline arrives from the bottom edge.
  • Frame 13: mid-hand-off the header's links sit on a black chip while the Contact pill stays yellow on the yellow ground, so it reads as bare text; the progress chips "WHY RTARIUM / THE CHALLENGE" also sit over the rising headline.
  • All frames: captured with the page's scroll-holding disabled so mid-transition positions are real; in normal use the page settles on the screens (01, 03, 05 and so on).

Captured from the local dev build (localhost:5180), Edge headless with GPU, 1440 × 900.
